error[ZBX-E0436]: the store is in use by another zbx command
  while  importing a directory
  cause  'zbx store gc' (process 4242) holds the store lock; nothing was changed
  holder 4242 gc
  fix    wait for the other command to finish, then run this one again
  more   zbx explain E0436
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0436.html
